chose: The owner's takes are conditioned by TAKE_POLICY, a pure function of each take's samples. Tempo 1.2, pitch kept: the owner approved every take of the first real conversation at 1.2 ("use 1.2 for all my voices"), moving the 1.5 first named on #3554. Loudness -16 LUFS by a measured two-pass loudnorm, the essay voice's. Silences longer than 280 ms are cut to 280 from their middle, on the waveform's own silence (what worked in v5), never at transcript word boundaries, which clipped word endings; each join fades over 10 ms. What counts as voiced is any 10 ms frame within 30 dB of the take's speaking level (the 90th percentile of its speech-bearing frames, those 15 dB over its quiet, the 20th percentile of all its frames, so a short answer in a long take is measured by its words), never a fixed floor, so the phone's opening hiss is left out and a quieter take is cut the same. The record button's click is found by shape: a loud run of at most 40 ms, broadband (its sample-to-sample energy at least 0.3 of its energy), within 300 ms of the edge, with at least 50 ms of quiet between it and the voice; anything else loud is voice and kept, so a word starting within 100 ms of an edge, voiced or with an s's broadband onset, is never clipped. A turn keeps 60 ms before its first voiced frame and 120 ms after its last. Before the cut, an 80 Hz high-pass and afftdn denoise set from the take's own measured floor; a take whose floor stays above -50 dBFS is flagged noisy, never failed.
options: Shape-based screener and speaking-level threshold, 1.2x, 280 ms gaps, -16 LUFS (chosen)
A fixed trim of each take's first and last 300 ms
A fixed hiss floor in dBFS
gray: How fast, loud and tight the owner's own voice sounds is what the owner hears in every conversation; their words moved between 1.5 and 1.2, and no check settles the screener's thresholds.
undo: Edit TAKE_POLICY in packages/video-render/src/owner-takes.ts; a turn's own conditioning (conversation/2) overrides tempo, loudness and the gap per turn.
